## Runtime Selection

Six animated character variants are imported:

- `character-a.fbx` and `texture-a.png`
- `character-b.fbx` and `texture-b.png`
- `character-c.fbx` and `texture-c.png`
- `character-e.fbx` and `texture-e.png`
- `character-f.fbx` and `texture-f.png`
- `character-g.fbx` and `texture-g.png`

Each FBX contains Generic-skeleton animation takes including idle, walk,
sprint, attacks, interaction, pickup and death. The rig omits some Humanoid
required transforms, so the project uses a shared Generic Animator Controller.
Project materials, prefabs and the controller are generated under
`Assets/Demo02/Art`.
